patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Create a new text file in the game install folder named 'ShowMeSomeBooty', with the .txt extension deleted (may have to make it visible to delete it if it's hidden), or download the premade file from the link below and put this in the folder It's working if: In the options menu, there are is a new 'CHEATS' submenu uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
